Rosehold Treasures

Level 4 is the last level, so these are the party's last growth. Award them where found; none is cursed unless it says so. Room keys refer to @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.cde61798bfdf1c71]{Rosehold}.

The founders' keepsakes

Given by a freed Echo (see @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.470935ba9bf636fa]{The Four Founders}). Each recharges at dawn.

Keepsake Room Effect
Hilde's Buckler A4 Shield, Armor +1. Once per Rest, as a Reaction, take a hit meant for a friend At Hand; your Armor counts double against it.
Aethelgard's Shears B4 Silver, d6. Cuts any thorn, vine, web or rope without a test. Thorn-sealed doors open to them. Against plant creatures, ignore Armor.
The Songkeeper's Chime C3 1 GD relic: Back to Bed or Glitter Spray. Rung with no dice, it simply calms: one frightened or grieving creature will listen to you.
Wren's True Map E2 Shows every room of the castle the bearer names, including secret doors. Outside the castle: once per journey, a Wrinkle while travelling simply does not happen.

Found treasure

Item Room Effect / value
Silvered halberd B6 d8, two-handed, silver.
Frostproof cloaks (3) B6 Advantage on tests against cold; ignore the Deep frost Wrinkle.
Hound-master's whistle B2 Briar hounds that hear it SAVE or sit. One use per scene.
The Stablemaster's horseshoes (4, iron) B3 A fey or thorn creature struck with one tests SAVE or loses its next turn. Filly already carries a fifth.
Sergeant's pay chest B5 60 SP and a ring of castle keys (opens every ordinary door on Levels 1 and 2).
Gold coupe with emeralds C3 200 SP. Anyone who drinks from it at the frozen feast is Befuddled.
The scullions' stew C4 A hot meal for six. Counts as a Picnic meal and ends Weary.
Portrait of five friends C5 Worth nothing. Carrying it into the throne room gives advantage on the first test made to reach Morwenna.
The second control orb D5 Commands animals, like Sebastian's. The Queen's side used it on the castle's beasts. Smash it (any blow) or keep it: keeping it is a WITS test for anyone still under the Dragonfilch Curse.
The Grave relics D5 The Baron's deliveries: 300 SP of grave goods, and whatever the party remembers him digging for. Returning them to Willowbrook's dead is an epilogue beat.
Aurelius's horn-shavings D5 A twist of paper. Sprinkled on a wound: heals 2d4+4, three doses.
Red dragon statue with ruby scales D5 1,000 SP, takes two slots. Not a hoard item; no curse.
Ulrik's grimoire E3 Animate, Restoration, Disguise, Haste. WITS with disadvantage to read, or Befuddled.
Robe of the First Luminary E4 Morwenna's, from before. +1 Gift Die while worn without armor. It still smells of roses.
@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-items.Item.f58df1187b7639a2]{Morwenna's Journal} E4 See its entry.
Winter rose (1) E5 Never wilts. Given freely to someone, it ends one Trauma.
The Queen's hand mirror E6 Cursed Mirror: shows only the viewer's worst qualities. Turned on Morwenna in the throne room, it shows her the princess she was (she loses her next turn).
@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-items.Item.3a5abf456a08e314]{The First Silver Rose Pin} F3 See its entry.
